items.summary: Workspace outbound access protection (OAP) is generally available for Power BI semantic models and interactive Power BI reports in Microsoft Fabric workspaces. With OAP, workspace admins can limit which data sources semantic models reach. They can also limit which semantic models in other workspaces interactive reports can query. These rules help reduce unintended outbound access and mitigate data exfiltration risks. Semantic model creators choose their data sources. Report authors choose their semantic models. items.summary: Pre-Calculating HugePages for PostgreSQL Huge pages ( HugeTLB ) are one of the most important PostgreSQL tuning steps , and they must be right before the server starts. They matter mainly for stability and reliability, more than for speed. Recently I also came across reports of up to 30% performance gain as an added benefit, but only for very specific workloads. One challenge is that the huge pages available on the host should be a near perfect fit for what PostgreSQL is going to request: If there are too few , PostgreSQL either refuses to start or quietly runs without huge pages. If there are too many , the extra pages stay unused. Memory s…
